Two things limit this answer. The devkb graph resolved none of the callers (its pack said "Incomplete"). Everything below comes from grep and reading the source, and I did not trace delegate invocation or the full runtime call chain.

`ValidationContext<T>.GetFromNonGenericContext` is defined at `src/FluentValidation/IValidationContext.cs:204`.

## Production methods that call it directly
- `AbstractValidator.IValidator.Validate` (`AbstractValidator.cs:85`)
- `AbstractValidator.IValidator.ValidateAsync` (`AbstractValidator.cs:90`)
- `DefaultValidatorOptions.When`, in the `Func<T, ValidationContext<T>, bool>` overloads for `IRuleBuilderOptions` and `IRuleBuilderOptionsConditions` (lines 202 and 217). The call is inside the condition lambda, so it runs when the condition is evaluated.
- `DefaultValidatorOptions.WhenAsync`, in the context-taking overloads for both builder types (lines 310 and 325). It is inside the lambda here too.
- `RuleBase.IValidationRule.GetDisplayName` (`Internal/RuleBase.cs:204`), when the context is not null
- `ConditionBuilder.When` (`Internal/ConditionBuilder.cs:50`), in the local function `Condition`
- `ConditionBuilder.WhenAsync` (`Internal/ConditionBuilder.cs:116` and `:126`), in the local function `Condition`

## Methods that reach it indirectly
- **Overloads that call the context-taking `When`/`WhenAsync`:**
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.When`, in the `Func<T, bool>` overloads (lines 175 and 188)
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.Unless`, in all four overloads (lines 231, 244, 257 and 270)
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.WhenAsync`, in the `Func<T, CancellationToken, Task<bool>>` overloads (lines 283 and 296)
  - `DefaultValidatorOptions.UnlessAsync`, in all four overloads (lines 339, 352, 365 and 378)
- **`ConditionBuilder.Unless`** calls `ConditionBuilder.When` (line 88).
- **`ConditionBuilder.UnlessAsync`** calls `ConditionBuilder.WhenAsync` (line 153).
- **Callers of `IValidationRule.GetDisplayName`:**
  - `DefaultValidatorExtensions.ForEach` (line 1178) calls `GetDisplayName(ParentContext)` inside a display-name callback.
  - `ValidatorDescriptor.GetName` and similar code calls `GetDisplayName(null)` (`ValidatorDescriptor.cs:54`). The null context skips the `GetFromNonGenericContext` call, so it does not reach it.
- **Callers of the explicit `IValidator.Validate` and `IValidator.ValidateAsync`:** these are the public non-generic entry points. Any production code that invokes them on an `IValidator` with an `IValidationContext` reaches the method. I found no such call sites in the library.

## Test files that exercise it
Condition tests (they use `When`, `Unless`, `WhenAsync` or `UnlessAsync`):
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ConditionTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/SharedConditionTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ChainedValidationTester.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/CollectionValidatorWithParentTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ComplexValidationTester.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/CustomValidatorTester.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ForEachRuleTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/RuleDependencyTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ValidatorSelectorTests.cs`
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/ValidatorTesterTester.cs`

Tests that call the explicit `IValidator` entry points or `GetDisplayName`:
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/AbstractValidatorTester.cs` casts the validator to `IValidator` at lines 203, 209 and 215, which exercises `AbstractValidator.IValidator.Validate` and `ValidateAsync`.
- `src/FluentValidation.Tests/RuleBuilderTests.cs` calls `GetDisplayName(null)`. That does not reach the target, but the file also uses `When`.

The test list was matched by grepping for `When`/`Unless` calls, not by checking that each test reaches `GetFromNonGenericContext`. Some of these files may only use the one-argument `Func<T, bool>` overloads, which still reach it indirectly.
